content.short: Wovula is a TON space strategy game with fleet management, resource trading, missions, and EXO credits.
content.description: Wovula is a Telegram and TON space trading simulation. Its TON App listing describes building a fleet, managing logistics, mining resources such as fuel, food, and ammo, trading with other players, and earning EXO Credits through missions and market activity. The game is built around a player-driven economy rather than a simple leaderboard loop. Wovula connects to TON through Telegram distribution, on-chain assets, token rewards, wallet-connected play, or community mechanics.
